card.title: Ki-84 FRANK
card.flavorText: The Nakajima Ki-84, code named "Frank" by the Allies, was a Japanese single-seat fighter aircraft used during the last two years of WWII. The Ki-84 was considered the best Japanese fighter, because it combined high speed capability with excellent maneuverability, and excellent firepower. The aircraft was a perfect match against any Allied single engine fighter, plus it had enough firepower to take down the high flying and well-defended Boeing B-29 Superfortress.
